_comment: FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY — not real ground truth, not S-6 evidence. It lives under docs/ and MUST NOT be copied into var/s6_corpus/annotations/. expected.text: Any other machine-printed text on the page may also be listed with no canonical_identifier — S-6 scores OCR text presence, and canonical_identifier is optional per-field metadata.
